thread:
acme_ops: Hi, we pulled the usage CSV export after your backfill and multiple days are missing for our account (2025-02-22 -> 2025-02-25). Dashboard shows tokens for those days, invoice includes them, but CSV export has empty rows. Can you help?
jenna_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact export parameters you used and a tiny snippet of the CSV? quick checks first: account id, date range, and whether you used API or Console export.
acme_ops: Using the Console -> Billing -> Exports -> CSV, date range 2025-02-20 to 2025-02-28, account: acme-corp-42. Attached a redacted snippet:
```
date,account_id,model,request_tokens,completion_tokens,total_tokens
2025-02-22,acme-corp-42,gpt-4o,0,0,0
2025-02-23,acme-corp-42,gpt-4o,0,0,0
2025-02-24,acme-corp-42,gpt-4o,0,0,0
2025-02-25,acme-corp-42,gpt-4o,0,0,0
```
But in the Dashboard -> Usage the same days show ~1.2M tokens. Invoice line item also matches dashboard.
jenna_support: thanks — can you also check if the exported CSV file shows the same zeros when downloaded, or if this is the Console preview? also if possible run the exports API so we can get request ids: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage/exports?account=acme-corp-42&start=2025-02-20&end=2025-02-28"`
acme_ops: downloaded file from Console. I ran the API too, same result. Response had export_id `exp_20250301_9876`.
sam_eng: @jenna_support I'm seeing a backfill job that ran during that window — job id `backfill-20250226-7c9d` targeting the hourly aggregation path. usage_bot: Backfill job backfill-20250226-7c9d status: partial_success. Failed partitions: 2025-02-22T00..2025-02-24T23 (403 transient S3 read error). Successful partitions were requeued for retry shortly after.
sam_eng: digging in — retry succeeded for most partitions but looks like the final CSV export stage used the pre-backfill materialized table for exports (race): the export read from aggregated table snapshot taken at 2025-03-01T02:00:00 before the requeue completed. That snapshot had zeros for those dates.
mike_billing: Customer sees invoice with tokens — billing pipeline consumed raw-usage stream which included the events; invoices were generated from the raw stream (not aggregated snapshot) so that explains invoice vs CSV mismatch. Need to confirm what to show to customer and whether we can regenerate their CSV.
jenna_support: ok — two action items: (1) regenerate the CSV export for acme-corp-42 using the post-backfill aggregated table (we can trigger a forced re-export), (2) confirm the backfill retries and S3 error root cause and log correlation. I'll ask eng to kick off re-export and give a new CSV URL. @sam_eng can you run a one-off export for account acme-corp-42 for 2025-02-20..2025-02-28?
sam_eng: starting one-off re-export now. command: `python infra/tools/export_usage.py --account acme-corp-42 --start 2025-02-20 --end 2025-02-28 --output s3://redwood-exports/support/exp_reexport_acme_1751203456.csv`
usage_bot: Export job exp_reexport_acme_1751203456 queued. tracker: https://internal.redwood/jobs/exp_reexport_acme_1751203456
acme_ops: thanks — how long will that take? we need the file for our audit.
sam_eng: ETA ~15-25 minutes depending on scan. I'll post link when ready. Also saving the raw event request_ids for those dates to double-check token accounting. please send any request_ids you have from your side.
acme_ops: we don't have request_ids at that granularity, we just reconcile totals from our logs vs invoice.
jenna_support: understood. once re-export finishes we'll attach new CSV and confirm token totals match invoice (or provide mapping if still different). I'll keep this thread updated and escalate to infra if export fails. :thumbsup:
usage_bot: Export job exp_reexport_acme_1751203456 completed: s3://redwood-exports/support/exp_reexport_acme_1751203456.csv (public link expires in 7d).
sam_eng: I pulled the re-export — rows for 2025-02-22..2025-02-25 now show non-zero tokens. quick diff: original CSV total_tokens=0 vs re-export total_tokens=1,213,478. Looks aligned with invoice.
acme_ops: confirmed we downloaded and reconciled — numbers now match. thank you, appreciate the quick turnaround.
jenna_support: closing loop — root cause: backfill job had transient S3 read failures, initial aggregated snapshot used by console export predated successful retries, causing zeroed rows. Fix implemented: ensure export reads latest aggregation snapshot, and infra added retry/backoff on the backfill fetcher. open: infra to add alert for partial_success on backfill jobs.
mike_billing: also flagged billing docs to note that invoices are generated from raw stream and exports may reflect snapshots (we should add a note in the Console export UI).
acme_ops: ok, if you can add that note in UI that would stop confusion. thanks again.
jenna_support: will file a UI task — thanks all, closing thread.
